name: git-sich
description: Private git layers sharing one working tree with a normal (public) repo

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target node --outfile dist/cli.js --define SICH_DEV=${SICH_DEV:-false} && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.docs:example: pnpm run build && sh scripts/make-example.sh > docs/example.md
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && SICH_DEV=false pnpm test && SICH_DEV=false pnpm run build
